blocks.content: On 13 August 2026, the Union Minister for Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare approved ₹605.71 crore for Rajasthan and Telangana under the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (PM-RKVY) and the Krishonnati Yojana (KY). The allocation was finalised in a virtual meeting held from Bhopal with the Union Agriculture Secretary and the agriculture ministers of Rajasthan and Telangana.

items: PM-RKVY is linked with state-specific agricultural planning and implementation.
Krishonnati Yojana functions as an umbrella scheme for several agriculture-related components.
Mother Sanction is a term used for the first major release of funds under a scheme or plan.
Kisan Credit Card is a credit facility for farmers to access institutional agricultural loans.
